    Suzanne LaFrance, Mayor
                            October 19 2026
                     GBOS Regular Meeting
                              Minutes Draft
         7:00 p.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 7:00 p.m. Jennifer Wingard, Co-Chair

Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Roll Call: Nick Crews (NC), Brian Burnett (BB), Kellie Okonek (KO), Amanda Tuttle (AT), Jennifer Wingard (JW)
Disclosures: During meeting BB discloses that he’s on the board of Girdwood Nordic Ski Club, related it item 7b.
Group reviews and determines no need for him to remove himself from discussion or vote.

Announcements:
    •  GHEC has one vacant position, to be filled by registered voters in the Girdwood Valley Service Area. To be
       considered for appointment, email gbos@muni.org.

    •  MOA GBOS Quarterly Meeting is scheduled for MON Oct 26 at 4PM at the Girdwood Community Room.

    •   Girdwood Trails Committee is applying for an RTP Grant to work on the Beaver Pond Trail. Send comments or
       concerns to tylerms@muni.org or kelleykt@muni.org before Oct 30.

Agenda Revisions and Approval:   October 19 2026 GBOS agenda approved with amendments: KO/NC   Assent
                                 Item #13 moves to Old Business due to time constraints KO/AT       Assent

Presentations (10 Min):
MOA Exploration of Waste-to-Energy facility, Kelli Toth, SWS Director, presenting: MOASWS is looking in to combusting waste to
produce electricity, reclaimed mental would also be sellable.
More info: Anchorage's Waste-to-Energy Project - Anchorage Waste-to-Energy Project



           GBOS Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos

Hightower Road Safety Concern for pedestrians on sidewalk at Crow Creek Mercantile, John Wros, presenting
Concern that trucks cannot see pedestrians when they hop the curb. This is within MOA right of way and parking was
adjusted between MOA traffic and Safeway during construction. Solution will need to come also from MOA ROW and
Safeway, and will need GBOS support for funding of whatever solution is determined. Item appears as New Business
so that action can be taken once solution is agreed upon.

Consent agenda: None

Reports (5 Min):
1.  Legislative Report
    Sen. Cathy Giessel: Working on conveyances of state DNR land to AIDEA.DCCED working out outsourcing payroll,
    working through concerns regarding this loss of state jobs and control to possible extensive out-sourcing.
   Ky Holland: Working on status of natural gas contractual issues for storage to ensure that there is not a shortage
    of gas supply
    Old Girdwood Watershed Stakeholders meeting is scheduled for Oct 27 from 1P-3P will include Railroad, MOA,
   DNR, DOT and will be held at Coast Pizza. Meeting is to address the concerns of the levy and culverts and flooding
    in Old Girdwood.
   Assembly members – Z. Johnson/Keith McCormick: No report
   Anchorage School Board Liaison – Rachel Blakeslee: No report
   HLBAC Report – Tim Charnon: No report

2.  Supervisor Reports
   KO: Anticipating a nomination from Alyeska Resort to participate at GHEC to help inform about Alyeska plans for
   employee and other housing.
   AT: AWWU tour today, Kids and Kops event on SAT was well-attended; update on PSAC activity in PSAC minutes
   KO & NC: Met with Visit Anchorage and received positive input on the GVSA TIPS proposal.
   JW: GHEC considering change to state law to support workforce housing tax abatement.

3.  Committee updates to GBOS: 3 min each; items not on the agenda but items of interest to the community
    Briana Sullivan: WUI CAT meeting end of Sept discussed practice held using autonomous fire
    detection/suppression.

        Glacier Valley Lodge Airport development

Amanda Tuttle: Concern that Girdwood economy is upside down and not sustainable.
John Boyle: Candidate for State House

8.  Discuss agenda topics for October 26 MOA GBOS Quarterly Meeting (Girdwood-based) (Staff)
    Group reviews and makes changes. Revised agenda will be posted tomorrow.

9. PSAC Request for letters to DOT requesting DOT provide a liaison to attend meetings in Girdwood (Tuttle)
    Aviation letter/Roads letter
   Change in administration soon, group is advised that being involved in the transition team for the new governor would be helpful.
   AT will write letter to be sent after election.

     Letter to DOT requesting liaison is still needed, but more helpful if addressed to the commissioner who will be leading DOT in
    2027. Cathy Giessel makes suggestions and offers assistance from her Chief of Staff. This letter can be written and ready to send
    once commissioner is in place. Group discusses having a joint meeting with LUC and DOT decision-makers to communicate the
    concerns and then having a liaison attend Girdwood meetings for continued follow-up.

     In future agendas these topics will be split into two items.

10. GBOS consider writing a letter to Department of Environmental Conservation regarding AWWU discharge violations (Tuttle)
   AT will review information from AWWU tour and contacts. No action for this meeting.

11. GBOS request: MOA release data regarding bed tax accrued in Girdwood. (Crews)
   NC is accruing information and has plan to meet with Bob Doehl in the next week. No action or this meeting.


                                                                                         3

12. GBOS Bylaws revisions (Wingard/Crews)
   GBOS Rules and procedures changes and redline are posted on the website. Copies are available at the library, Post Office and
    Community Room bulletin boards. Comments accepted through Nov 13 will be reviewed by GBOS at their November meeting.

13. GBOS Representative(s) for Ky Holland and Girdwood Watershed stakeholders meeting scheduled for end of October. (Wingard)
    Nick Crews agrees to participate along with Amanda Tuttle at this meeting, scheduled for Oct 27 1PM-3PM at Coast Pizza.

NEW BUSINESS:
14. Timberline Road improvements funding via Lease-Leaseback to be proposed to voters in the 2027 MOA election. (Kelley)
    Lease-Leaseback of municipal owned property in Girdwood could provide funds for Timberline Road paving and improvements.
    Working on ballot prop language to forward to the Assembly to consider for the Municipal election in April. GBOS

15. Public request for GBOS Resolution requesting Traffic Dept Safety Division’s recommendation to improve safety at the Merc
    parking lot/sidewalk. (John Wros)
    Discussed under Presentations.

16. PSAC request for GBOS Resolution of Support to MOA traffic requesting double-sided no parking signs on Davos Road (Tuttle)
     Staff will help in drafting resolution for next GBOS meeting.

17. PSAC request for GBOS resolution of Support to declare a temporary moratorium on approval of stream setback variances in
    Girdwood, pending outcome of Engineer Review of the discharge volume at the levy at the trestle and identification of resources to
    be used to protect Old Girdwood in the event of failure of the levy. (Tuttle)
   JW requests that this item is addressed at Land Use Committee before GBOS takes action.
   KO at AT will work on the draft letter for the next GBOS meeting.

18. Proposal for Girdwood Comprehensive Plan Amendment (Tuttle)
   AT introduces that as DNR land the Girdwood Comprehensive Plan is an update to the Girdwood Area Plan.

Motion to extend meeting by 5 minutes to 10:05 KO/NC
    Group discusses that they need a legal opinion to understand. Ky Holland offers help from legislative legal services, also MOA
     legal could provide opinion.

19. Title 25 and HLB Land Disposal Procedures (Tuttle)
   AT is concerned that the HLB is not following their disposal procedures as outlined in T25 and there is Assembly action on Monday
    evening, without meeting any of the requirements for environmental review, etc.
   The item on MON at the Assembly is transfer of the Girdwood Industrial Park Lot from HLB to MOA Street Maintenance –
    Girdwood. As an inter-government transfer, it is not subject to the same requirements as disposal. GBOS has discussed this
     transfer and supported it.
